description:
What the overthinking/socially anxious person doesn’t realize…

Is they actually have a high level of social intelligence

But because they lack confidence - all of the information they’re taking in about the people around them is used to scrutinize their worthiness

It’s directed inward “what does this mean about ME” 

And so they freeze up, they can’t handle the amount of information they’re receiving

But if you just started meditating

Encountering that fear and releasing it

Getting to a place of TRUE confidence

You’d see that you can still READ people

But WITHOUT THE INSECURITY

This makes it easy to connect - makes it EASY to be SOCIAL

your social anxiety is a super power disguised as a deficiency

You just had to get to a place where you LOVE YOURSELF

Simple.
transcript: What the overthinking, socially anxious person doesn't realize is that they're actually socially intelligent, much more so than the average person. But instead of utilizing that social intelligence to connect with other people, it's directed inward. They're picking up on every nuance of the things that are going on around them, the body language, how this person's emotional state is. And it's all reflecting inward and it's saying, do they like me? Does that mean that I'm good? Am I good enough yet? Do I fit into this environment? And because of the overload of information, you're stifled, you freeze up. You're like, I can't do this, right? But here's the key. If you could just start working through your anxiety, if you started meditating, if you started encountering that fear and letting it go, and you started to become more confident, you'd find that you have a very easy time connecting with others because you can read them so well. It's a superpower disguised as a deficiency. You just have to work through the anxiety.
